title: Governor of Sutos
summary: The governor of Sutos serves as an advisor to Prince Zan-Grier of Sutos. He was previously loyal to Grier's father, Zan-Sutos, and remained so of his memory during the civil war of Sutos Island.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
When Grier returned to the island and defeated Zan-Gason, Sutos' governor recognized him as Prince Zan-Grier and handed him an Amulet containing the Titan, Megataur. The governor, along with other inhabitants of Sutos Island, tried to stop Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill from attacking Grier's Suits. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

The governor was present when the Huntik team returned to Sutos asking for Grier's help against Rassimov and the Blood Spiral. [An Ally from the Organization]
